prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent sprite atlas for a painterly meadow butterfly wingbeat animation.
Input images: Image 1 and Image 2 are STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCES ONLY: the existing yellow wildflower and white daisy sprites. Do not include any flower, stem, leaves or scenery in this new image.
Create ONE landscape 2:1 PNG containing EXACTLY EIGHT isolated poses of the SAME small warm apricot-yellow butterfly, in a strict equal FOUR-COLUMN TWO-ROW grid. True transparent alpha background, no painted checkerboard, no shadows, no ground, no text or labels.
Butterfly design: graceful rounded forewings and smaller rounded hindwings, softly scalloped cream edges, restrained warm umber thin veins and a few small warm-brown markings. Slender olive-brown body, two fine antennae. Keep identical wing markings and proportions throughout. Match reference visible paint strokes, angular hand-painted light and shadow planes, soft matte colors, illustrated 3D volume with a 2D painterly finish. No neon, no glow, no black heavy comic outlines, no photorealistic photographic texture.
Camera: fixed front-upper three-quarter view, body axis vertical in the image, head at top and abdomen pointing down. Body remains the SAME SIZE and SAME POSITION in every cell: thorax/wing hinge exactly at cell center (50% width, 52% height); head and abdomen DO NOT bob, rotate or change length. Both wings articulate around the fixed thorax. Not eight different camera angles. Full-open wingspan 65% of cell width, full antennae and wingtips inside central 76% of every cell, wide clear transparent gutters.
Pose sequence in reading order, one continuous wingbeat:
0 wings fully spread sideways, near-flat, show upper painted surfaces, widest silhouette.
1 wings rise by about 25 degrees, still mostly spread, slightly narrower.
2 wings rise about 55 degrees, halfway folded, narrow diagonal silhouettes.
3 wings nearly upright at about 80 degrees, thin silhouette, tips above the body.
4 wings at the very top, 88 degrees, almost touching over the back, narrowest silhouette, no merged blob.
5 wings lowering to 65 degrees, beginning to open, tiny natural soft trailing-edge flex.
6 wings lowering to 40 degrees, broader, recognizable same pattern.
7 wings lowering to 15 degrees, almost as broad as pose 0, preparing to loop naturally back to 0.
The WING SILHOUETTE must visibly fold and unfold in depth; do not simply rescale the whole butterfly or repeat an unchanged flat butterfly. Keep bodily proportions and lighting completely stable. Exactly 8 cleanly separated full butterflies, no cropping, no extra insects.
correctionPrompt: Edit target: this exact eight-pose apricot-yellow butterfly wingbeat atlas. Keep the same butterfly, eight wing angles in the same reading order, painted veins and spots, body proportions, true alpha, and 2:1 four-column two-row layout. Correct SPACING ONLY: uniformly reduce all eight butterflies by 30%, with the same scale across cells, and place each thorax precisely at the center of its own equal cell, 50% width and 55% height. Every butterfly including all antennae, wings, edge brushwork must fit entirely within the central 72% of its cell width and 76% of cell height. Fully transparent clean gutters between cells, with no detached speckles, no overlapping or clipped tips. Keep the butterfly body the same size and vertical orientation throughout. Do not enlarge narrow folded-wing poses to fill their cells. No background, checkerboard, shadows, text, grid lines or additional elements. Exactly eight isolated poses, first full spread, fourth nearly upright, fifth fully upright, last nearly spread for a looping wingbeat.
processing: 原始 PNG 与 alpha 原样复制保存；Canvas 运行时采样、按身体注册点对齐，不导出裁切图，不程序重画像素。
